column1: # EXP-R2-224 first-round fitness scoring: ProteinGym substitutions (stage 20) and
# the MegaScale designed referent (stage 29), on all three rungs.
# All three rungs, not the two new ones. The freeze scores every rung on the frozen
# queues inside this campaign so the paired Delta-rho is formed within one run, and
# says in terms that the historical F10 and F12 ProGen2-medium numbers are not inputs
# to any gate here -- agreement with them is a reproduction diagnostic that cannot
# retune a frozen rule. Stage 42 reads a dtype from three stage-20 payloads and three
# stage-29 payloads, so three is also what the assembly expects.
# bfloat16, the pre-data amendment's binding declaration for these two endpoints, and
# the precision the existing medium artefacts already carry, so the reproduction
# diagnostic stays like-for-like. Stage 01 is float32 for its own recorded reason and
# is not this manifest's cells.
# Everything else is each stage's own default, which is what the medium payloads on
# disk were produced at: stage 20 at --variants 1000 --seed 20260807 --batch-size 16,
# stage 29 at --batch-size 512, which is that stage's published setting rather than
# its argparse default of 256 and is therefore stated.
# Both score stages read an input out of their own --out, which this runner injects:
# 20_retrieval_bound.py's score reads wildtypes.json and 29_designed_referent.py's
# reads cohort.json. Both are staged into each cell's output directory before dispatch,
# and neither is the cell's expect basename -- an input staged beside a result is not
# completion, which is why expect names the model payload exactly.
# One slot per stage, three cards, so each barrier waits on like-shaped cells.
